_comment: Flip tiktok to true ONLY after the TikTok Production app is approved and its keys are in Supabase (TIKTOK_CLIENT_KEY/SECRET) and src/lib/tiktokAuth.ts (TIKTOK_CLIENT_KEY, TIKTOK_PUBLIC).
